entries.zh: 乘；乘势取便，凭借（男子情爱中）所享的青睐与便利
entries.en: to avail oneself of the favor that men's love-affairs enjoy; the advantage enjoyed in amours
entries.notes: 汉字栏仅存「乘」，音写后半「l chiey」对应汉字无从确证，与西语短语（男子情爱所享恩宠）的结合属推断

entries.zh: 乘势；凭借势利以行事、办成事情
entries.en: to avail oneself of power or favor; the favor by which one gets things done

entries.zh: 着力；出力帮衬，用力扶持
entries.en: to exert oneself on someone's behalf; to back and support

entries.zh: 超拔；提拔抬举（天主教语境亦指超度、拯救灵魂）
entries.en: to raise up and exalt; to favor; (Catholic) to deliver souls
entries.notes: 音写「mal cay」标记 T99 污損難辨，后半汉字不可读；「超拔」提拔/超度两义并存，无法定夺

entries.zh: 重赏；厚赏酬报，以重赏示恩
entries.en: to reward richly; lavish reward or recompense
entries.notes: 汉字第二字有 [疑:賞/償]，酬赏或偿还两读并存

entries.zh: 权势；在官府治理中的权柄势力
entries.en: power and influence; favor in government

entries.zh: 权要；当权显要，掌权的要人
entries.en: men of power and position; those in authority

entries.zh: 乡情；同乡情谊，惠及乡亲之情
entries.en: affection for one's homeland; partiality toward one's countrymen

entries.zh: 靠势；倚仗他人势利，依托有势力者
entries.en: to lean on others' power; to favor oneself through the influential

entries.zh: 照顾；照看顾护，遮护周全（如以帷幔遮庇）
entries.en: to look after; to shelter and protect (as with a veil)
entries.notes: 音写「cou」标记 T99 污損難辨；汉字「照顧」与西语对应尚清晰，但按封存件缺损标记降为低置信

entries.zh: 权衡；权柄轻重，斟酌权衡
entries.en: the weighing of power, discretion; (as given) favored by the lord
entries.notes: 汉字「權衡」与西语「得主上恩宠」难以互证，释义无法定夺

entries.zh: 展脚手；伸展开手脚，放开手脚自由行事（首字或为「长」）
entries.en: to stretch out one's hands and feet; to act freely, spread oneself
entries.notes: 汉字首字有 [疑:展/長]，西语释义截断为「faborecido -」

entries.zh: 无影话；无根无据的虚话，寓言荒诞之谈
entries.en: fables; baseless talk, tales without substance

entries.notes: 音写「quey / y / y」多处标记 T99 污損難辨，附加音节无法确证

entries.zh: 轻；轻省不重，轻便易携（轻则免人负重）
entries.en: light in weight; easy, freeing one of the load
entries.notes: 西语缩写「p̄es」的展开（peso 重量／比索银钱）依赖推断

entries.en: an easy thing; something readily done

entries.zh: 无乜恶；毫无难处，毫不费难（第二字「也」或为「乜」）
entries.en: without any difficulty; an easy thing, no trouble at all
entries.notes: 汉字第二字有 [疑:也/乜]，按闽南语「无乜＝没有什么」读作「毫无难处」属推断

entries.zh: 最易；最为容易（办成、做成）
